library(tidyverse)

# Exercises

## Exercise 1 — Glimpse and describe (5 points)

**Goal:** Inspect the size and variable types of `earthquakes`.

```{r glimpse-earthquakes, eval = FALSE}
glimpse(earthquakes)
```

> 123 rows, 7 variables each

## Exercise 2 — Variable names (5 points)

**Goal:** Check that column names follow good R style.

```{r names-earthquakes, eval = FALSE}
names(earthquakes)
```

> The names are short and different.

## Exercise 3 — Count by region (5 points)

**Goal:** Produce a sorted frequency table.

```{r count-region, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes %>%
count(region) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

``` {r}
earthquakes %>%
  select(region)
```

## Exercise 4 — Bar plot of top 5 regions (5 points)

**Goal:** Filter to the five most frequent regions and draw a bar chart.

```{r visualize-earthquake-regions, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes %>% 
  filter(region %in% c("Turkey", "Iran", "China", "Japan", "United States")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = region)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

## Exercise 5 — Faceted histograms of richter (5 points)

**Goal:** Compare magnitude distributions across the top five regions.

```{r visualize-earthquake-richter, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes %>% 
  filter(region %in% c("Turkey", "Iran", "China", "Japan", "United States")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = richter, fill = region)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic()
```

> Replace this text with whether the center of `richter` depends on region, and why.

## Exercise 6 — Select, drop NAs, and count removed rows (10 points)

**Goal:** Build a complete-case subset and report how many rows were lost.

```{r earthquakes-subset, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes_subset <- earthquakes %>%
  select(richter, month, year, deaths) %>%
filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
filter(!is.na(richter)) %>%
filter(!is.na(deaths)) 

glimpse(earthquakes_subset)
  

```

>Lost 2 rows. Went from 123 to 121.

## Exercise 7 — Re-level month and redraw the violin plot (5 points)

**Goal:** Explain alphabetical factor order and correct it.

```{r visualize-earthquakes-deaths, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes_subset %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic()
```

> `April` appears on the left instead of `January` beacause month is a character type. So it is alphabetized

```{r recode-month-levels, eval = FALSE}
earthquakes_subset %>% 
  mutate(month = fct_relevel(month,
                           "January",
                           "February",
                           "March",
                           "April",
                           "May",
                           "June",
                           "July",
                           "August",
                           "September",
                           "October",
                           "November",
                           "December")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic()
```
